terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D object-space terms and evidence refs.

referenceCamera.note: Three orthographic-like views constrain the complete exterior. Internal ink, roller and underside geometry remain inferred.

objectClass.notes: Front, side and back views establish the outer enclosure, paper support, output tray, controls and rear inlet. Printhead, cartridge bay, internal rollers and underside details are not visible.

reasoning: The broad rounded shell is simple, but front and rear articulated paper systems, inset output cavity, controls, rollers, feet and a purpose-readable paper animation require a complex runtime hierarchy.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Compound articulated assembly with radial repetition and mixed transparency.

detailInventory.note: Each observed or inferred identity detail maps to a named component local feature or material override.

details.description: Broad cream rectangular enclosure with strongly rounded shoulders and lower corners.
Thin horizontal top-lid seam wraps across the front and side.
Tall rear paper support leans backward and frames the input sheet.
Wide Sakura-pink rear backplate with rounded corners and lower finger recess.
Single warm-white paper sheet rises above the rear support.
Deep pink inset output bay with dark inner throat.
Projecting Sakura-pink output tray with thick rounded front rim.
Centered shallow grip recess in the tray front edge.
Warm-white page rests on the output tray and emerges from the throat.
Large layered circular Sakura-pink power/action button.
Small circular indicator sits to the right of the main button.
Paired dark feed rollers are visible inside the output throat during operation.
Square rear power inlet with black circular core.
Continuous pink lower rear band separates shell from feet.
Four shallow Sakura-pink rubberized feet support the enclosure.
Pale broad edge highlights follow the shell corner radii.
Raised pink inner lip follows the rectangular output opening.
Two pink vertical guides flank the input page.

definitionOfDone: The printer matches the three-view silhouette and proportions, preserves the cream/pink material zoning, separates all paper-handling assemblies, and unmistakably prints and ejects a page during the 5.2 second powered cue.
